links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM answers to ACL questions rated by orthopedic consultants on 5-point Likert scale
links.effect: All models scored mean accuracy ≥3 (mostly accurate). DeepSeek 3.61 and Grok 3.59 were significantly higher than Llama 3.25 (P<0.05); ChatGPT 3.48, Gemini 3.52.
links.quote: DeepSeek (3.61) and Grok (3.59) demonstrated significantly higher mean accuracies than Llama (3.25; P < 0.05).

screen.reason: The study empirically compares the accuracy of five LLMs responding to typical patient questions regarding ACL tears, evaluated by orthopedic consultants. It evaluates model accuracy alone without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
